# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor  <sub>[v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v5 c31 P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027)</sub>
- **Titles:** Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>; Dr. Carrow  <sub>[v4 c13 P7](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0007), [v5 c31 P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, handsome youth with broad shoulders, wavy chestnut hair, and mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes. He possesses a mouth often contorted into a mocking grin and has an open, bright expression.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh is lively, mischievous, and fond of teasing, yet possesses an engaging sense of humor and warmth. He is ambitious, intelligent, and fiercely determined in his pursuits, showing strong perseverance and high academic ability. Though he can display stubborn resolve, he is friendly, open-minded, and willing to apologize when he realizes he has caused offense.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v4 c29 P38](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0038), [v4 c30 P2](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0002)_

## History

Hugh grew up in Brierley and attended school there, where he gained a reputation for teasing the girls and competing fiercely for academic top honors with Nell Harcourt. After teasing Nell about her red hair on her first day, a long-standing academic rivalry and rift began between them, though Hugh expressed remorse and sought her friendship. Upon finishing at Regent's as medalist, he taught at Pale Sands to save money for university expenses, relinquishing the local school position to Nell. After entering Wexcombe for college, Hugh studied medicine, eventually earning High Honors in Classics and winning the Cooper Prize, though the intense work led to severe exhaustion and a bout of typhoid fever. Over time, his feud with Nell turned into friendship and later romance. Following their marriage, Hugh took over his great-uncle Dr. David Carrow's medical practice at Glen St. Agnes in Seven Gulls, establishing his home and family there while serving as the local physician.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P60](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0060), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v3 c20 P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v5 c4 P25](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0025), [v5 c31 P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027)_
